# @three-ws/walk

> A diverse, animated 3D avatar that walks and talks over your web pages — corner companion + full-page playground, with a built-in avatar picker. Powered by Three.js.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-walk-sdk
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-walk-sdk/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/walk
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-walk-sdk/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-walk-sdk/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-walk-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
